single_bottleneck: The first Host PowerShell Direct cleanup probe used the reserved read-only variable $PID for the recorded Guest helper PID, so the probe failed before querying or terminating the process.

reproduction.error: Cannot overwrite variable PID because it is read-only or constant
reproduction.guest_side_effect: none verified; Stop-Process was not reached

expected: Host cleanup probes use a task-specific variable name and report the exact before/after process state.
minimal_change: Rename the temporary variable to RecordedHelperPid and retry the same exact PID query/termination; do not broaden the target set.
verification: control/agent-helper-cleanup.json must contain the before/after process records and baseline hash checks.
rollback: No rollback; the failed probe made no Guest state change.
